dismissals.because: tests/test_standards.py:128 the logger example is documentation shipped to client repos; making Forge's Python-only CI install a TypeScript-capable Node just to execute a docs example adds a moving part the done-when never asked for; the example is corrected and the test runs wherever Node is present

findings.body: The logger regression test skips whenever Node is absent, allowing broken logger output to pass the suite without being exercised. The suite command in forge.toml:5 and CI setup in .github/workflows/forge.yml:19–21 provision Python tooling only. Checking for any Node executable is also insufficient: the test directly executes TypeScript, which older Node versions cannot run this way; [Node documents the type-stripping version requirements](https://nodejs.org/api/typescript.html). Ensure the suite provides a compatible runtime and executes this required regression test instead of silently skipping it.
findings.title: Not done: logger output regression test always runs in the repository suite

why: Forge's standards page and conventions pages miss about 22 constitution rules a worker needs, three places where the pages disagree with each other, and name AWS CDK where the owner chose Terraform
